d: Join the Team at ABYAT - Your Gateway to Retail Excellence!

Are you ready to be part of the largest retail store in the Middle East? ABYAT, spanning an impressive 22,000 square meters and offering over 22,000 products, is your one-stop destination for all things home improvement and more. From elegant tiles and captivating wallpapers to state-of-the-art lighting solutions and stylish kitchen fixtures, we pride ourselves on offering a diverse array of top-quality products under one roof.

Established locally with a vision for excellence, ABYAT has been setting benchmarks since its inception in September 2005. With an unwavering focus on our customers, we've crafted an experience that revolves around their needs, from our meticulously designed store layouts to our unparalleled service offerings.

Expanding beyond our roots in Kuwait, ABYAT is now making waves in Saudi Arabia and setting our sights on Qatar and the UAE. As we continue to grow, we're seeking passionate individuals to join our dynamic team and contribute to our journey of success.

The Customs Clearance Coordinator is responsible for day-to-day shipment and document follow-up for import and export shipments by sea, air, and land. The role coordinates with internal teams, customs brokers, shipping lines, freight forwarders, and government authorities to support timely and compliant customs clearance and accurate shipment reporting.
q: 3-5 years of relevant experience in customs clearance, shipping, import/export, freight forwarding, or logistics operations in Kuwait.
Good knowledge of Kuwait customs clearance procedures and shipping documents for sea, air, and land and cross-border shipments.
Practical experience coordinating with customs brokers, shipping lines, freight forwarders, suppliers, and internal teams.
Good knowledge of Excel and shipment tracking/reporting; familiarity with ERP/ SAP.
Arabic and English communication skills are required.
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field.
Familiarity with Kuwait government portals and approval requirements, including MOH, CITRA, EPA/Ozone, PAI, Ministry of Commerce, and other authorities as applicable.
Knowledge of COC, technical inspection certificates, import permits, and related clearance approvals is preferred.
r: Track daily import and export shipments by sea, air, and land until customs release and delivery.
Follow up clearance progress with appointed customs brokers and escalate delays or issues when needed.
Collect, review, and file shipping and customs documents received from supply chain, business units, suppliers, and freight forwarders.
Check document completeness and identify discrepancies before customs submission.
Verify HS code classification and declaration accuracy in coordination with brokers and internal teams.
Prepare and follow up on required approvals, permits, COC, and technical inspection certificates when assigned.
Use relevant Kuwait government portals such as MOH, CITRA, EPA/Ozone, PAI, Ministry of Commerce, and other authorities as applicable.
Coordinate with customs brokers, shipping lines, freight forwarders, warehouse teams, Supply Chain, and business units.
Provide regular shipment status updates and support resolution of operational requirements.
Prepare shipment tracking reports and daily activity reports accurately and on time.
Handle clearance-related petty cash, supporting documents, and reconciliation in line with company procedures.
Maintain accurate shipment records and support compliant import/export execution.
Report documentation gaps, customs holds, inspection issues, or other risks to the Senior Officer / Team Leader.
Coordinate transportation execution after customs clearance by arranging trucks with approved transporters for both domestic and cross-border shipments.
Follow up on shipment dispatch from port, airport, or bonded facilities to warehouse or final destination.
Monitor shipment movement and ensure on-time delivery according to operational timelines.
Coordinate with warehouse and transportation teams to ensure smooth inbound and outbound shipment handling.
Track transportation status through the system and ensure shipment visibility until final delivery completion.

d: The Legal Counsel will serve as the primary legal advisor for matters across Saudi Arabia, the wider Middle East and other international markets. Reporting to a ses executive, the Legal Counsel will work directly with the CEO, leadership team and business units on corporate governance, M&A, commercial contracts and regulatory matters.
This role suits a lawyer who can lead complex negotiations and help business leaders make timely, commercially sound decisions in a fast-growing technology company.
q: Law degree (LLB or equivalent). An LLM is preferred.
At least seven years of relevant legal experience, with a background in corporate law, M&A and technology contracting, alongside experience advising on data privacy and AI matters.

Strong knowledge of the Saudi legal and regulatory environment. A licence to practise in Saudi Arabia is preferred. Candidates with substantial experience advising on Saudi and wider Middle Eastern matters are also encouraged to apply.
Demonstrated experience handling cross-border matters and coordinating with business teams external advisors across multiple jurisdictions.
Experience in a startup or high-growth technology business is strongly preferred. A multinational in-house or law firm background is an advantage.
Sound commercial judgment and the ability to turn complex legal advice into clear recommendations.
Confidence advising executives, board members and other senior stakeholders.
Ability to work independently, collaborate across teams and manage competing priorities as the business grows.
r: Advise the CEO and leadership team on business expansion, investments and strategic partnerships.
Support the board and shareholders on governance matters and explain the legal implications of decisions under consideration.
Oversee corporate structuring, licensing and regulatory filings in Saudi Arabia.
Draft and maintain shareholder agreements, board resolutions and other corporate records.
Coordinate governance requirements across jurisdictions with local advisors.
Lead the legal work on mergers, acquisitions, investments and cross-border transactions.
Manage legal due diligence and advise leadership on material findings and their implications for deal terms.
Draft and negotiate memoranda of understanding, term sheets, share purchase agreements, shareholders’ agreements and related transaction documents.
Draft and negotiate strategic partnership agreements, enterprise customer and vendor contracts, SaaS agreements and technology licences.
Advise on data protection and AI governance obligations and reflect them in commercial agreements.
Protect intellectual property and confidential information through clear ownership, licensing and confidentiality terms.
Advise business teams on applicable Saudi and international regulatory requirements.
Identify legal risks, explain their commercial impact and recommend practical ways to address them.
Engage and manage external counsel when specialist or local advice is required.
x: You will have a direct voice in decisions about market expansion, investments and commercial partnerships. The role offers the opportunity to lead regional and international transactions and shape how a growing business contracts for technology, protects its intellectual property and puts AI governance into practice.

d: The Showroom Sales Executive is responsible for handling and facilitating customer enquiries and sales activities within the showroom and through digital channels. The position requires a customer-focused and commercially motivated individual who can sell products, prepare reports, monitor stock information, and follow company policies and procedures.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration/ Marketing or relevant
2 years of relevant experience in sales and communication role
Excellent Customer Service and Sales skills
Professional written and verbal communication skills to effectively promote Nass Commercial's portfolio
Basic understanding of digital marketing platforms
Excellent analytical abilities and attention to detail
r: Follow company sales policies, operational procedures, and approval limits
Handle both online and offline sales activities
Prepare sales and inventory reports using approved digital and AI tools
Maintain high standards of showroom appearance and product presentation
Prepare quotations, orders, invoices, and customer records accurately
Achieve assigned individual and showroom sales targets
Follow up on sales leads, open quotations, and pending customer decisions
Monitor product availability and report inventory shortages
Provide professional customer service before, during, and after the sale
Resolve routine customer complaints and escalate serious cases appropriately
Coordinate with internal departments to complete customer orders
Support team members and contribute to a positive sales environment
Develop the necessary skills to supervise the showroom and lead the team
Adhere to Nass Corporation standards and CIG in all marketing activities
To adhere to the requirements of Nass Commercial's integrated management system (IMS)
